reason: Full Dangan Teio entry-turn player attack permissions/restrictions, Chitta other-Fire-attack history and Guardman, and Skid first actual Muutopia hand discard mandatory draw.
validationNotes: Start and post-verification nameKey counts from actual dist/cards.json are 9333 and 9336. Baseline 07d7a661 inspected; no staged/working changes or prior processes were running. Existing definitions, IDs, aliases, catalogue, save formats and old image references unchanged.

Three original cards and one exact-name Dangan reprint were checked against official full faces, basic information, current restrictions, printed mana and all four viewed images. Eleven fuzzy Chitta results were filtered to one exact name. Same-name reprints are not counted.

Dangan uses native entry-turn player prohibition and a generalization of the existing Gambo player permission, rather than Speed Attacker. Permission applies to all own fresh creatures including itself and ability-ignored recipients, never allows fresh creature attacks, and disappears with an inactive source. Opposing fresh speed/evolution creatures may attack creatures but cannot attack its controller. Existing attack prohibitions continue to apply.

Chitta uses native Guardman and other-attack conditions. Attack declaration captures current civilization in an additive public history field, so departed attackers remain counted and later civilization changes cannot rewrite history. Either player Fire creatures qualify, the same current creature never counts itself, and summoning sickness remains unchanged.

Skid uses actual hand-discard events and a turn-scoped first-Muutopia record even before a source enters or while ignored. Both players and effect controllers, simultaneous discards, multiple sources, twinpact race identity, ignored sources, queued source departure, next native turn, empty discard, ordinary hand-to-mana, milling and replaced discards are covered. The mandatory draw does not become optional.

Official QA31877 actual Skull twinpact regression is included; Skid is a race-specific analogue. QA40670 actual Emperor first-discard regression is included; Skid simultaneous Muutopia checks use the same first-event principle. No unregistered source is claimed as exact reproduction.

56 distinct focused tests and 273 affected regressions pass, total329; check, audit, nameKey recount, campaign verification and baseline invariants pass. One legal forty-card seeded game preserves all80 physical IDs and JSON legal actions. Encrypted online choice and first-discard state survive storage without leaking the other hand.

Two edge fixture failures omitted owner:self on a discard task; corrected fixtures pass. Four initial online-client failures were caused by not yet regenerating online-compatibility after the engine/cards changes; regenerated metadata and all four pass. No remaining failure from this batch. Historical whole-suite/long/registered-card/reprint deferrals remain unchanged. No push/publication/Netlify update.
